title: Care rules for children under five, pregnancy, older adults and immunocompromised people
jurisdiction: Global default from public guidance; national rules replace it

rules.audience: children under 5, pregnant people, older adults, immunocompromised people
rules.message: Raw or undercooked egg dishes are not served to vulnerable groups.
rules.source: WHO Five Keys to Safer Food (cook thoroughly); national food-safety agencies' advice for vulnerable groups

rules.message: Eggs for vulnerable groups are cooked until yolk and white are firm.
rules.source: WHO Five Keys to Safer Food

rules.message: Raw meat preparations are not served to vulnerable groups.
rules.source: WHO Five Keys to Safer Food

rules.message: Raw fish is not served to vulnerable groups.
rules.source: WHO Five Keys to Safer Food

rules.message: Unpasteurized milk and soft cheeses made from it are not served to vulnerable groups.
rules.source: WHO Five Keys to Safer Food; Codex Code of Hygienic Practice for Milk and Milk Products (CXC 57)

rules.message: Raw sprouts carry a higher risk; cook them for vulnerable groups.
rules.source: National food-safety agencies' advice on sprouted seeds

rules.message: Limit high-mercury fish in pregnancy and for young children.
rules.source: WHO and FAO Joint Expert Committee on Food Additives guidance on methylmercury

rules.message: No honey for infants under one year (infant botulism).
No whole nuts or hard candy for children under five (choking).
No hard candy for children under five (choking).
Cooked rice out of temperature control for more than 1 hour is not served to vulnerable groups (stricter than the 2-hour general rule).
rules.source: Derived from WHO Five Keys (keep food at safe temperatures) and national guidance on Bacillus cereus in cooked rice

rules.message: Hot-held food for vulnerable groups stays at or above 63 °C.
rules.source: Tightened from WHO 60 °C guidance to match several national codes
WHO Five Keys to Safer Food

rules.message: Sodium above 600 mg in one meal for older adults (about 2 g per day over three meals).
rules.source: Derived from the WHO sodium guideline (2012): under 2 g sodium per day

rules.message: A main meal for older adults under 500 kcal risks undernutrition.
rules.source: Derived from Sphere minimum ration planning figures (about 2,100 kcal per person per day) divided over meals; to be confirmed by a dietitian

disclaimer: DRAFT derived from public guidance. Not medical advice. Excludes infant formula, therapeutic feeding and condition-specific diets, which need clinicians. Must be reviewed by a registered dietitian and a food-safety officer before adoption; record reviews in 'reviews' and set status to 'reviewed'.
